title: Final net angle (part a)
description: Essential: The net rotation angle for part (a) must be given as approximately -4 m h θ / (M R) to leading order in h/R.

title: Final net angle (part b)
description: Essential: The net rotation angle for part (b) must be given as 4 m π r² / (M R²).

title: Angular momentum conservation
description: Important: The solution must apply conservation of angular momentum about the pivot for each leg of the ant's motion.

title: Disk angular velocity relation
description: Important: The disk's angular velocity must be correctly related to the ant's motion via ω_disk = - (m/M) * (v_ant, tangential / (R/2)?) or equivalent, using the disk's moment of inertia (I_disk = MR²/2).

title: Integration for circular path
description: Important: For part (b), the solution must integrate the angular displacement over the ant's full circular trip, or correctly use the ratio of moments of inertia.

title: Leading order approximation
description: Optional: The answer for part (a) explicitly uses the binomial approximation (1 - h/R)² ≈ 1 - 2h/R to find the leading order term.

title: Radial movement analysis
description: Important: The solution must state that during the purely radial leg (h movement), the disk does not rotate because the ant exerts no torque about the center.

title: Sign error in rotation
description: Pitfall: Incorrect sign for the disk's rotation direction (e.g., missing the negative sign in part (a) final answer).

title: Moment of inertia mistake
description: Pitfall: Using an incorrect moment of inertia for the disk (e.g., MR² instead of MR²/2) in calculating the angular velocity.
